Messages.Author: Jeroen
Messages.Body:
Simple (not too mention dumb and unnecessary) Q :-)

Are Bloodbrothers who assist each other in combat, considered to be in
combat themselves?

By card text/ rules I'd say no, because it isn't mentioned anywhere.
But by backstory (see for example Coagulated Entity) they should be.

Relevant?
Yup: Burst of Sunlight: Combat, Thaumaturgy
[tha] Strike: 1R, aggravated, to all vampires in combat. [THA] Strike:
2R, aggravated, to all vampires in combat.

Jeroen
